on-error-continue.type: TYPESAFE:INVALID_QUESTION_SET, TYPESAFE:INVALID_STATE, TYPESAFE:INVALID_IMAGE, TYPESAFE:TOO_MANY_OPTIONS, TYPESAFE:REJECTED, TYPESAFE:UNSUPPORTED_BY_PROVIDER, MULE:EXPRESSION
on-error-continue.doc:name: Bad request

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { state: payload.state default {}, questions: payload.questions default {}, model: if (isBlank(payload.model default "")) null else payload.model, images: payload.images default {}, instructions: payload.instructions default null, criteriaTrue: payload.criteriaTrue default null, criteriaFalse: payload.criteriaFalse default null, options: payload.options default {}, noMatchOption: payload.noMatchOption default null, levels: payload.levels default [], policy: payload.policy default null, decision: payload.decision default null }
%dw 2.0 import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries output application/java --- (payload.images default {}) mapObject ((data, ref) -> (ref): fromBase64((data as String) replace /^data:[^,]*,/ with ""))

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { payload: payload, attributes: if (attributes != null) (attributes - "rawResponse") else null, elapsedMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.startedAt, operation: vars.operation, httpCall: vars.httpCall }
